LightningMessageChannel.description: Tells the Google Client home page which part of the configuration is open, so the side panel can show the matching setup guide.

lightningMessageFields.description: Either "context" (published by the configuration wizard) or "ready" (published by a panel asking for the current context).
The configuration section that is open, for example "drive" or "ai".
The variant selected inside the section, for example "admin", "developer", "gemini" or "agent".
Either "main" for the setup screen or "advanced" for advanced settings.
The active advanced settings tab when the advanced view is open.
